alerts.title: US 50 Rock Scaling-149807
alerts.description: Between Red Creek Road and Elk Creek Road (15 to 16 miles west of the Gunnison area) from Mile Point 139 to Mile Point 140. Road closed due to rock fall mitigation. Starting October 19, 2026 at 7:00AM MDT until October 22, 2026 at about 4:00PM MDT. Full schedule below: • October 19, 7:00AM - October 22, 4:00PM Comment: ⚠️TRAVEL ALERT⚠️ | US 50 (Blue Mesa Reservoir) Traffic Holds 🚧7:00 a.m. to 4 p.m. 🚧| Monday, Oct. 19 - Thursday, Oct. 22 Expect daily 20-minute traffic holds on US 50 (Mile Points 139–140) while crews safely perform rock mitigation. Motorists should plan for anticipated traffic holds up to 20 minutes while crew perform necessary rockfall scaling. For safety, drivers are advised to stay on US 50 and remain inside their vehicles during holds. All work is weather-dependent and subject to change. 🌐More info: COtrip Planner App or COtrip.org

alerts.title: US 160 Pagosa Springs Reconstruction-147597
alerts.description: Between US 84 and Pike Drive (Pagosa Springs) from Mile Point 144.3 to Mile Point 141.8. Road construction. Starting October 21, 2026 at 7:00AM MDT until October 21, 2026 at about 6:00PM MDT. Full schedule below: • October 21, 7:00AM - October 21, 6:00PM Comment: Harman Park & Piedra Road-Work is underway at this intersection of US 160. Working hours will be intermittent day and night so motorists should plan for potential delays, Monday-Saturday. Please allow extra time to get through the work zone. Safety benefits of this work includes pedestrian safety upgrades and ADA accessibility improvements. Expect lane shifts and up to 15-minute delays. Crews will switch two-way traffic into the eastbound lanes, perform temporary striping operations and begin asphalt milling in the westbound lanes. Parking will not be permitted on US 160 and vehicles will be towed at the owner's expense. Westbound lane closures, 10’ width and 75’ length restrictions will remain in place 24/7 through end of 2026. Work is weather-dependent. For questions contact the project team at 970-335-9230 or Pagosa160reconstruction@gmail.com Project Webpage: www.codot.gov/projects/us160pagosasprings
